name: Fantasia
source:
Our nameless hero wakes up injured, with no memories and a unfamiliar pissed off young lady by his side.

Agreeing to stay in the nearby mansion, while trying to regain his memories…what kind of answer will await him at the destination?

[from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/10/25/game-review-digicla-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
无名的主人公醒来时身负重伤，记忆全失，身旁还坐着一位陌生而怒气冲冲的年轻女子。

为了找回记忆，他答应暂住在附近的宅邸。旅途终点等待他的，究竟会是怎样的答案……？

[内容取自[url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/10/25/game-review-digicla-special/]Koorin的博客[/url]]
